Definitions.Description: Definition of a convex subset of R^n (contains the line segment between any two points).
Definition of a convex function (inequality condition).

Lemmas_and_Theorems.Description: The sublevel set {x | f(x) <= a} of a convex function is a convex set.
Lemmas_and_Theorems.Used_In: Proving convexity of constraint sets in almost all exams (e.g., Jan 2021, Jan 2022)
Used with Lemma 4.27 to show linear inequalities define convex sets

Lemmas_and_Theorems.Description: The intersection of convex sets is convex.
Lemmas_and_Theorems.Used_In: Combining multiple constraints to prove the feasible region C is convex

Lemmas_and_Theorems.Description: A 1-variable twice differentiable function is convex iff f''(x) >= 0 (strictly convex if > 0).
A several-variable twice differentiable function is convex iff its Hessian matrix is positive semidefinite.
Lemmas_and_Theorems.Used_In: Checking convexity of objective functions in almost all exams

Existence_and_Uniqueness.Description: A continuous function on a compact set attains a global minimum and maximum.
Existence_and_Uniqueness.Used_In: Justifying existence of solutions (e.g., Jan 2021, May 2025)

Existence_and_Uniqueness.Description: A strictly convex function on a convex set has at most one global minimum.
Definition of a convex optimization problem (minimizing convex f over convex C).

Methods.Description: Necessary (and sufficient for convex problems with Slater's condition) conditions for optimality.
Methods.Used_In: Solving optimization problems in almost all exams

Methods.Description: If an optimal solution is in the interior, it must be a critical point (gradient is zero).
Method for optimizing over a closed bounded set by checking critical points in the interior and optimizing on the boundary.
Definition of critical points (gradient equals zero).
Second derivative test for local extrema (Hessian definiteness).

Definitions.Description: Definition of a bounded set (contained in a ball).
Definition of closed sets and the fact that intersections of closed sets are closed.
Definition of a compact set (closed and bounded).
Definitions of Interior (strict inequalities) and Boundary (equalities).

Results.Description: Definition of Positive Semidefinite matrices (v^T A v >= 0).
Criteria for positive definiteness (eigenvalues, principal minors).
Matrix inversion and solving linear systems.
Symmetric reductions/schematic procedure for checking positive semidefiniteness.

Items.Used_In: Solving linear inequality systems (Jan 2023, Jan 2024, May 2024)
